summary: Move classCoord(c) across the Gram matrix; it fixes the frame.

steps.claim: Z_lat(termPosition) = fᴴ·J_lat·(classCoord(c)·γf) (frameGram_eq_frameImage, frameImage_termPosition), and J_lat·classCoord(c) = (classCoord(c)⁻¹)ᴴ·J (classCoord_conj_splitGram); so it remains to see that (classCoord(c)⁻¹f)ᴴ = fᴴ.
steps.lean:
simp [frameGram_eq_frameImage, frameImage_termPosition, ← classCoord_conj_splitGram c,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc, map_splitGram_ratMiddle, -splitGram]

steps.claim: classCoord(c) fixes the frame vectors e_a and z (it acts only on X₀ and the lattice change does not move z), which gives the remaining identity.
